sources.elevation: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt90n000eb (16 ppd, ~3.7 km)
sources.slope: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt90n000eb (16 ppd, ~3.7 km)
sources.roughness: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt90n000eb (16 ppd, ~3.7 km)
sources.relief: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt90n000eb (16 ppd, ~3.7 km)
sources.thermal_inertia: MGS TES thermal inertia (8 ppd, 60 N - 50 S only)
sources.mineral_index: Mars Odyssey GRS Fe (5 deg smoothed, wt%)
sources.temperature_day: ESTIMATED: linearised diurnal heat model from TES albedo + thermal inertia (equinox, no atmosphere)
sources.temperature_night: ESTIMATED: linearised diurnal heat model from TES albedo + thermal inertia (equinox, no atmosphere)

steps: MOLA: big-endian int16 metres -> mean/std/max-min per 0.5 deg cell; slope at 16 ppd
TES: float32 maps, out-of-range values (TI = 0) -> NaN, mean per cell
GRS: 9999.999 -> NaN, 5 deg bins copied to the 0.5 deg cells they contain
Temperatures: modelled where both albedo and thermal inertia exist
HARMONIZED: DEM block-mean x1 -> 3.7 km pixels; slope at that baseline; roughness/relief over 3x3 px
notes: Silicon (si_sr_5x5) downloaded but not in the schema; keep for later mineral ratios.
